methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page using WebFetch on 2026-06-14. Where the official page returned HTTP 403 or rendered prices via JS templates only, a reputable aggregator (GetApp, Sematext blog, SolarWinds Slashdot listing) was used as primary source, noted in each vendor's provenance. All USD figures reflect self-serve published rates. 'monthlyUsd' for annual plans is the annualized monthly rate; month-to-month rates noted where published. Loggly official pricing page returned HTTP 403; starting price sourced from GetApp (reputable aggregator). Papertrail official pricing page returned HTTP 403 on both /plans/ and /pricing/ paths; plans sourced from GetApp aggregator and corroborated by Slashdot starting-price listing. Sematext Logs official pricing page renders prices via JS templates; concrete plan prices sourced from Sematext's own blog comparison article. Sumo Logic publishes no public self-serve USD prices; all plans listed as null with contact-sales notes. Mezmo publishes no public self-serve USD prices. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null on all plans as this is a non-telephony vertical.

vendors.name: Datadog Logs
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.datadoghq.com/pricing/?product=log-management fetched 2026-06-14. HIPAA/BAA confirmed via Datadog Trust Center. Usage-based model with no flat tier; all plans use 'custom' billingModel. Annual commitment prices listed; on-demand rates are 1.5x annual.

plans.name: Ingest
plans.notes: $0.10/GB ingested or scanned (annual) or $0.10/GB on-demand. Covers processing, enrichment, live tail, archiving, and dynamic routing. No flat monthly price — pure usage-based.

plans.name: Standard Indexing
plans.notes: $1.70/million log events/month (annual) or $2.55 on-demand. 15-day default retention; 3, 7, 30+ day options available. Real-time exploration, alerting, Watchdog Insights included.

plans.name: Flex Storage
plans.notes: $0.05/million events stored/month (annual) or $0.075 on-demand. Up to 15-month retention for historical investigations and compliance.

plans.name: Flex Logs Starter
plans.notes: $0.60/million events stored/month (annual) or $0.90 on-demand. Retention 3, 6, 12, or 15 months. Includes bundled Starter Compute for logs below 2B events/month.

vendors.name: Better Stack
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://betterstack.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Telemetry (log) bundles priced per region; US East prices used as reference. Annual pricing shown; monthly prices are approximately 18% higher. Free tier includes 3 GB logs with 3-day retention.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 3 GB logs/month, 3-day retention. Also includes 10 uptime monitors, 1 status page, 100,000 exceptions/month, 5,000 session replays.

plans.name: Telemetry Nano (US East)
plans.notes: Annual rate $38/month ($456/year). Month-to-month rate $45/month. 40 GB logs (and 40 GB each of traces, metrics, web events) with 30-day retention. EU region: $25/month annual.

plans.name: Telemetry Micro (US East)
plans.notes: Annual rate $150/month ($1,800/year). Month-to-month rate $180/month. 160 GB each of logs, traces, metrics, web events with 30-day retention. EU region: $100/month annual.

plans.name: Telemetry Mega (US East)
plans.notes: Annual rate $315/month ($3,780/year). Month-to-month rate $375/month. 340 GB each of logs, traces, metrics, web events with 30-day retention. EU region: $210/month annual.

plans.name: Telemetry Tera (US East)
plans.notes: Annual rate $630/month ($7,560/year). Month-to-month rate $750/month. 700 GB each of logs, traces, metrics, web events with 30-day retention. EU region: $420/month annual.

vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://www.sumologic.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. No public self-serve USD prices are listed; page describes Essentials and Enterprise Suite tiers with 'contact sales' pricing. Flex usage-based pricing exists but no unit costs published publicly. HIPAA eligibility mentioned for Enterprise Suite on official page.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Contact sales for pricing. Targeted at small-to-medium DevOps/SecOps teams. Unlimited log capacity, up to 50,000 metrics/day, up to 5 GB tracing/day, up to 365-day retention, up to 500 real-time monitors.

plans.name: Enterprise Suite
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited logs, metrics, and tracing. Cloud-native SIEM, threat intelligence, 24/7 support, HIPAA eligibility.

vendors.name: Logz.io
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://logz.io/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Consumption-based model; $0.92/GB/day for log management. Pro and Enterprise tiers offer unlimited volume via subscription. Monthly billing at 1.2x annual rate. Overage at 1.4x subscription cost. 14-day free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Log Management (pay-as-you-go)
plans.notes: $0.92/GB ingested per day. Retention options: 3, 7, 14, or 30 days hot storage. Additional warm storage $0.015/GB/day, cold $0.001/GB/day. No flat monthly price — pure usage-based.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited daily data volume, unlimited retention. Annual billing standard; monthly billing at 1.2x annual cost. Overage at 1.4x subscription cost.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. Unlimited data volume and retention. Includes agentic observability features at $10/million tokens or per AI agent workflow invocation.

vendors.name: Grafana Cloud Logs
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page https://grafana.com/pricing/ fetched 2026-06-14. Free tier: 50 GB logs/month, 14-day retention. Pro tier: $19/month platform fee plus usage at $0.40/GB write + $0.05/GB process + $0.10/GB retain, 30-day retention. Enterprise: custom, $25,000/year minimum. Adaptive Logs feature available on all paid plans.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 50 GB ingested logs/month, 14-day retention. Community support only. Also includes metrics, traces, and profiling at no cost.

plans.name: Pro

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing; $25,000/year minimum commitment. Customizable retention beyond 30 days. Deployment flexibility: public cloud, Federal Cloud, or BYOC. Premium support + Observability Architect.

vendors.name: New Relic Logs

Free tier includes 100 GB/month data ingest and 1 full platform user. Standard and Pro editions charge per full platform user plus $0.40/GB beyond 100 GB free. Data Plus option: $0.60/GB beyond 100 GB.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 GB/month data ingest (logs + all telemetry), 8-day default retention. 1 full platform user + unlimited basic users. 500 synthetic checks. No credit card required.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $349/user/month on annual commitment; $418.80/user/month pay-as-you-go. Unlimited full platform users. 100 GB/month free ingest, then $0.40/GB. 2-hour critical response SLA. Data Plus eligibility, extended retention options.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact sales. FedRAMP Moderate and HIPAA eligibility. 1-hour critical response SLA, 24/7 priority support. Data Plus included. Custom commitment options.
